## Learning Goals {background-color="#1B4332"}

*Objectifs d'apprentissage*

By the end of today, you can:

- Explain indirect resistance: recruiting a third party (a natural
  enemy of the herbivore) instead of fighting the herbivore directly
- Give examples of tritrophic interactions
- Explain how plants can actively recruit natural enemies of herbivores
- Describe the classic HIPV discovery experiment and learn how to design experiment to test your hypothesis
